additional_info.body:
Dear Yigit Balkanoglu,
We could see in the charger history that the contactor fault had occurred 3 in December. We resetted the converter count on the charger, and performed a hard reboot. After that we could see that the charger issue got resolved, and we have also seen a charging session happening successfully on the charger.
If the same fault occurs, we request you to create a new ticket and then the contactors would be needing a check in the future. Let me know if we can close the ticket.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
